SELECT ag.auth_group_seq, ag.auth_group_cd, ag.auth_group_nm, ag.auth_group_desc, ag.use_yn FROM adm_auth_group ag WHERE 1=1
AND ( ag.auth_group_nm LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR ag.auth_group_cd LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY ag.auth_group_seq

SELECT m.menu_seq, m.up_menu_seq, m.menu_nm, m.menu_url, m.menu_type_cd, m.icon_class, m.sort_ord, m.use_yn, LEVEL AS tree_lvl,
/* 그룹-메뉴 매핑 상태 */ NVL(aam.perm_lvl, 0) AS perm_lvl, NVL(aam.use_yn, 'N') AS map_use_yn FROM adm_menu_mst m LEFT JOIN adm_auth_menu aam ON aam.auth_group_seq = #{authGroupSeq} AND aam.menu_seq = m.menu_seq START WITH m.up_menu_seq IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR m.menu_seq = m.up_menu_seq ORDER SIBLINGS BY m.sort_ord, m.menu_seq
mapper.update: MERGE INTO adm_auth_menu t USING ( SELECT #{auth_group_seq} AS auth_group_seq, #{menu_seq} AS menu_seq FROM dual ) s ON ( t.auth_group_seq = s.auth_group_seq AND t.menu_seq = s.menu_seq ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.perm_lvl = #{perm_lvl}, t.use_yn = #{use_yn}, t.updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, t.updated_by = #{updated_by} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( auth_group_seq, menu_seq, perm_lvl, use_yn, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{auth_group_seq}, #{menu_seq}, #{perm_lvl}, #{use_yn}, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{created_by}, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{updated_by} )
mapper.select: SELECT LOGIN_ID, PWD_HASH FROM ADM_USER_MST WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{user_id} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
